name: ada-hds-strasbourg
description: AccesDirectAide HDS service (Mon Coffre, shared-dossier data). Region osc-fr1, HDS option. Prepared in LAB, NOT deployed.

ALLOWED_ORIGIN.description: exact https origin of the main site (comma list), e.g. https://<APP_BASE_URL host>

HDS_TICKET_PUBLIC_KEYS.description: <kid>:<base64 SPKI DER> of the main API ticket signer (scripts/hds-keygen.mjs prints it)

HDS_DATA_KEYS.description: <kid>:<64 hex> key-encryption keys, first = active; generated in the HDS environment only, never copied elsewhere

addons.description: PostgreSQL Business 512M (HDS-eligible plan; verify the exact plan id with `scalingo addons-plans postgresql`)
